visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair, wearing a beige suit over a white shirt, is seen in an indoor setting with a wine rack behind him. He enthusiastically holds a sliced pineapple close to the camera. (2) He transitions to holding a glass teapot containing yellow tea and herbal ingredients like dates. Bright studio lighting illuminates the scene. (3) The scene cuts to a top-down view of a woman's hands slicing a fresh pineapple on a green cutting board. (4) Various ingredients including sliced pineapple, dried white herbs (Yuzhu), dried chrysanthemum flowers, goji berries, and red dates are displayed on a light blue plate. (5) The woman pours the plate's contents into a white pot filled with water on a black induction stove. (6) The camera shows a close-up of the tea bubbling and simmering in the pot with visible herbs floating. (7) Back to the man, he pours the golden tea into a double-walled glass cup. Graphics of pineapples and text overlays float in the background. (8) He gestures with the cup while talking, and graphic inserts show skin textures and anatomical skin layers. (9) He takes a sip from the glass cup, tilting his head back slightly. (10) Brief clips from famous movies or dramas featuring female actresses appear as visual metaphors for beauty and confidence. (11) An animation of Donald Duck is shown briefly. (12) The man finishes by smiling and holding the tea cup towards the viewer, surrounded by sparkling graphic effects.
